variety_description: A good  yielding, early maturity, medium height, long-slender variety grown extensively  in Bihar under Irrigated upland to midland conditions. Developed by RAU (Bihar) and released in 2010. Excellent panicle exertion and productive tillering. Excellent grain elongation and quality after cooking with mild aroma. Tolerant to water stress and major diseases and insect pests.
